_comment: The frozen contracts promise fields. This ledger records the ones the
implementation does not honor under their own name, and the hand-written
types that mirror a frozen message. The check is
internal/platform/contractcheck: a field is honored when a hand-written
type carries it and the code uses it, or when it is listed here.

fenced.service.v1.RolloutConfig.min_read.reason: The kernel names the minimum ready time what it is.

fenced.service.v1.ServiceInstance.last_h.reason: The kernel instance carries the heartbeat as a timestamp.

fenced.service.v1.DeleteServiceResponse..reason: The ServiceManagementService gRPC server is not served; deletion answers through the Control API, which returns the terminated service.

fenced.service.v1.DrainInstanceResponse..reason: The ServiceManagementService gRPC server is not served; the supervisor drains an instance but no RPC answers for it.

fenced.syscall.v1.HandshakeRequest.clien.reason: The frozen SyscallService has no gRPC server. The ABI version is a kernel constant, and the runtime boundary is the Runtime Interface.

fenced.syscall.v1.HandshakeRequest.runti.reason: The frozen SyscallService has no gRPC server; the Runtime Interface carries no handshake.
The frozen SyscallService has no gRPC server; the Runtime Interface carries no handshake.

fenced.syscall.v1.HandshakeRequest.suppo.reason: The frozen SyscallService has no gRPC server; syscall support is declared by the runtime binding table instead.

fenced.syscall.v1.HandshakeResponse.enab.reason: The frozen SyscallService has no gRPC server; syscall support is declared by the runtime binding table instead.

fenced.syscall.v1.HandshakeResponse.kern.reason: The frozen SyscallService has no gRPC server. The ABI version is a kernel constant, and the runtime boundary is the Runtime Interface.

fenced.syscall.v1.HandshakeResponse.reje.reason: The frozen SyscallService has no gRPC server; nothing can reject a handshake that is never offered.

fenced.service.v1.RolloutConfig.drain_ti.reason: The kernel keeps the drain timeout on the spec, next to the rollout settings it applies to.

fenced.service.v1.ServiceInstance.starte.reason: The kernel instance records when it was created and when it last reported in; the moment the runtime started it is not tracked.

fenced.service.v1.ServiceSpec.env.reason: The kernel passes the environment through the workload spec; the service spec has no environment of its own.

fenced.service.v1.ServiceSpec.metadata.reason: The kernel calls the service metadata labels.

fenced.service.v1.ServiceStatus.target_v.reason: The status names the target version as part of the rollout state.
